entities.summary: Štefan "Štofi" Rosina is a Slovak racing driver and businessman. He is a race winner in the FIA GT1 World Championship, a former champion in the Lamborghini Super Trofeo Europe series’ Pro-Am category, and the current GT2 European Series champion.
